## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `TurboDL-Setup-0.4.0.exe` | Windows 10/11 (x64) |
| `TurboDL-0.4.0-arm64.dmg` | macOS on Apple Silicon (M1 and newer) |
| `TurboDL-0.4.0-x64.dmg` | macOS on Intel |
| `TurboDL-Firefox-0.4.0.xpi` | the Firefox add-on |

## What's new

- **Firefox support:** a Firefox build of the extension (download capture, video button, context menu, popup) that can also start TurboDL when it is closed.
- **More Chromium browsers:** Opera, Opera GX, Vivaldi and Arc can start TurboDL from the extension too.
- **Notifications:** clicking "Download complete" now shows the file in File Explorer or Finder, also after TurboDL was restarted. Before, Windows could open an empty Electron window.

## Updating

- Install the new version over the old one and open TurboDL once.
- Chromium browsers: copy the extension again with **Settings → Install the browser extension…** and press **reload (⟳)** on the TurboDL card on the browser's extensions page.
- Firefox: open `TurboDL-Firefox-0.4.0.xpi` in Firefox. Regular Firefox only installs add-ons signed by Mozilla; if this file is unsigned, use Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR with `xpinstall.signatures.required` set to `false`.

The apps are not signed: on Windows choose **More info → Run anyway**; on macOS right-click TurboDL → **Open** the first time (or run `xattr -cr /Applications/TurboDL.app`).
